confidence_notes: Numbeo's Can Tho prices were last updated in February 2026 and reflect only three contributors in the past 18 months. Cocktail and wine estimates use multiples of the local draft-beer price because direct city data is limited; accommodation estimates are holistic.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Can Tho averages; accommodation is estimated from basic lodging in mid-sized Mekong Delta and southern Vietnam cities.
